svg.title: Heralded T-state preparation, two attempts
svg.desc: Timeline of the heralded T-state kernel with two attempts, on D5's drive and readout lines and the controller link, with a closer look at the first answer below. Each attempt reads D5 out for 300 ns and sends the outcome to the herald function, whose answer is due 52 ns later: 4 ns on the link, at most 40 ns in the function and 8 ns of feedback. A pi pulse that plays only if the qubit read 1 starts the moment the answer is due. After the second attempt, a Y90 pulse and a pi/4 frame shift prepare the T state, and a last readout measures it.
